footer.tagline: Suprir's supplier portal: open quotes, clear rules and payment on the agreed terms.

hero.title: Sell to Suprir with clear rules and agreed deadlines
hero.subtitle: Register your company, get invited to quotes in your category and submit proposals through the portal. No middleman, no fees.

how.title: How to supply Suprir
how.subtitle: Four steps between registration and the first order. Every stage has a deadline and an owner.

cadastro.title: 1. Registration
cadastro.desc: Fill in the company details, pick the categories you serve and attach the documents.

homologacao.title: 2. Approval
homologacao.desc: Purchasing checks documents and tax compliance. The answer comes within five business days.

convite.title: 3. Invitation
convite.desc: An approved supplier joins the invite list for every quote in its category.

proposta.title: 4. Proposal
proposta.desc: Send price, lead time and payment terms through the portal. The comparison map treats every proposal the same way.

categories.title: What we buy
categories.subtitle: Eight purchasing families, from office supplies to outsourced services. Pick yours during registration.

integrity.title: Integrity is not a slogan
integrity.subtitle: The rule that applies to the supplier is the same one that applies to the buyer — and it is written down.

isonomia.title: Same information for everyone
isonomia.desc: Scope, quantity and deadline are published at once. Nobody gets details outside the portal.

sigilo.title: Proposals stay sealed
sigilo.desc: One supplier's price is never shown to another before the round closes.

conflito.title: Conflicts are declared
conflito.desc: A buyer with a personal or ownership tie to the supplier declares it and steps out of the round.

canal.title: An open channel
canal.desc: Suspected favouritism can be reported anonymously, with no retaliation.

cta.title: Ready to compete?
cta.subtitle: Registration takes less than ten minutes and covers every category you serve.

invoice.title: Electronic invoice

warranty.title: Minimum warranty

sample.title: Sample on request
sample.desc: Purchases above one hundred units may require a sample before the order is issued.

opportunities.integrityDesc: Every proposal stays sealed until the round closes and lands in the same comparison map.

policy.title: Purchasing policy
policy.subtitle: The rules behind every Suprir purchase, from a supplies request to a service contract.

competition.title: Three proposals minimum
competition.desc: Every quote seeks at least three valid proposals. With fewer, the purchase needs a written justification.

documents.title: Documents up to date
documents.desc: A supplier with an expired certificate is suspended until it is renewed and is not invited to new rounds.

confidential.title: Sealed until closing
confidential.desc: No price is revealed to a competitor before the round ends, not even over the phone.

deadline.title: The published deadline holds
deadline.desc: A proposal sent after closing does not enter the comparison map, no exceptions.

payment.title: Payment as agreed
payment.desc: The terms accepted in the proposal are the terms that reach the order and the finance team.

audit.title: Auditable choice
audit.desc: Choosing anyone other than the cheapest requires a recorded justification, stored with the quote.

policy.conflictDesc: Whoever decides the purchase must step aside in these situations and hand the round to another buyer.

conflict.relative: A relative up to the third degree working for the supplier or owning part of it.
conflict.gift: A gift, trip, event or courtesy received from the supplier in the last twelve months.
conflict.partner: Any ownership stake, however small, in the company making the offer.
conflict.former: Employment with the supplier that ended less than two years ago.

policy.channelDesc: To report favouritism, improper charges or pressure from either side of the negotiation.
policy.channelAnonymous: Reports may be anonymous. There is no retaliation against good-faith reporting.

prazo.q: Can I send a proposal after the deadline?
prazo.a: No. The portal closes the round on the published date and late proposals do not enter the comparison map.

documentos.q: Which documents must I keep current?
documentos.a: Federal tax clearance, payroll fund compliance and up-to-date articles of incorporation. The portal warns you before each expiry.

brinde.q: May I offer a gift to the buyer?
brinde.a: No. Any courtesy, however small, must be refused and reported to the integrity channel.

parente.q: I have a relative working at Suprir. May I compete?
parente.a: Yes, as long as the relationship is declared during registration. The related buyer leaves the round.

pagamento.a: On the terms accepted in the proposal, counted from the receipt of the checked goods and a correct invoice.

recusa.q: Why did my proposal lose even though it was the cheapest?
recusa.a: Lead time, payment terms and delivery history all weigh on the decision. When the winner is not the cheapest, the justification is recorded with the quote.

policy.footerNote: Document maintained by {{company}} and reviewed every twelve months.
